case_partitions.evaluation_policy: One retrospective diagnostic evaluation only. No interval, threshold, or model parameter may be changed after observing this split.

conditional_bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fixed pre-anchor donor weights; does not include donor-selection uncertainty.

split_conformal.nonconformity_score: maximum absolute local-effect error across all fixed effect-identifiable perturbations and magnitudes within one physical target site
split_conformal.scope: Target-cluster score prevents repeated perturbations at a site from being treated as independent calibration units.

interpretation_boundary: Coverage is evaluated only against injected synthetic local effects. It does not validate physical-bias intervals for real Method Code transitions.
